name.description: Unique name for the call queue.

phoneNumber.description: Primary phone number of the call queue. Either a `phoneNumber` or `extension` is mandatory.

extension.description: Primary phone extension of the call queue. Either a `phoneNumber` or extension is mandatory.

firstName.description: First name to be shown when calls are forwarded out of this call queue. Defaults to ".". This field has been deprecated. Please use `directLineCallerIdName` and `dialByName` instead.

lastName.description: Last name to be shown when calls are forwarded out of this call queue. Defaults to `phoneNumber` if set, otherwise defaults to call group name. This field has been deprecated. Please use `directLineCallerIdName` and `dialByName` instead.

timeZone.description: Time zone for the call queue.

callPolicies.description: Policy controlling how calls are routed to `agents`.

agents.description: People, workspaces and virtual lines that are eligible to receive calls.

callingLineIdPolicy.description:
Which type of Calling Line ID Policy Selected for Call Queue.
 * `DIRECT_LINE` - Calling Line ID Policy will show the caller's direct line number.
 * `LOCATION_NUMBER` - Calling Line ID Policy will show the main number for the location.
 * `CUSTOM` - Calling Line ID Policy will show the value from the `callingLineIdPhoneNumber` field.

callingLineIdPhoneNumber.description: Calling line ID Phone number which will be shown if CUSTOM is selected.

allowAgentJoinEnabled.description: Whether or not to allow agents to join or unjoin a queue.

phoneNumberForOutgoingCallsEnabled.description: When `true`, indicates that the agent's configuration allows them to use the queue's Caller ID for outgoing calls.

directLineCallerIdName.description: Settings for the direct line caller ID name to be shown for this call queue.

dialByName.description: The name to be used for dial by name functions. Characters of `%`,  `+`, `\`, `"` and Unicode characters are not allowed.
